tasks.name: Literature deep-dive and parameter extraction
tasks.summary: Extracted 20+ parameters from Rottinghaus 2022, Chlebek 2023, Williams 2022. Escape rates 1e-9 to 3e-5.

tasks.name: Implement single-layer kill switch ODE models
tasks.summary: Implemented deterministic ODE and stochastic models for 6 architectures. Fixed IS element double-counting bug.

tasks.name: Implement stochastic escape dynamics
tasks.summary: Serial passage simulation with Poisson mutation and binomial dilution. 100 replicates per condition.

tasks.name: Implement multi-layer combination framework
tasks.summary: Correlation-aware combination model. Pairwise and triple combos tested at 4 correlation levels.

tasks.name: Validate against experimental data
tasks.summary: 5/5 escape rate predictions within 1 OOM. Mean log error = 0.029. Time predictions off by 4-6x.

tasks.name: Optimize combination strategies
tasks.summary: 20/30 combos meet NIH. Best triple: CRISPR+OG+Aux at 6e-18, 13% cost.

tasks.name: Ablation and sensitivity analysis
tasks.summary: Each layer provides 1e6-1e8 fold protection. OG most sensitive (S=1.00), Aux most robust (S=0.181).

tasks.name: Generate publication-quality figures
tasks.summary: 6 figures: architecture comparison, heatmap, correlation, Pareto front, validation, ablation.

tasks.name: Write complete paper draft
tasks.summary: Full paper with abstract, introduction, results, discussion, methods, references (~4500 words).

tasks.name: Write research process documentation
tasks.summary: RESEARCH_PROCESS.md documenting topic selection, methods, bugs, and limitations.
